pages.text: Moonblossom is a glowing flower (night vision in suspicious stew). Glow Fern, Glow Algae and Lumen Reeds carpet the land and swamps. Lumen Fruit gives brief night vision; Lumen Nectar (bottle a $(l:stillbloom_basin)Stillbloom$(/l)) gives regeneration.
Right-click soil with a Lumenberry to plant a bush. Bone-meal it to ripen; right-click a ripe bush to harvest — it regrows. Lumenberries also breed $(l:native_fauna)Lumen Grazers$(/l).
Glowcap Stew — hearty, with night vision. Returns the bowl.
